description.zh: 清空或删除DNA库作业ID，可以从[提交清空或删除DNA库作业](~~209341~~)的返回参数中获取。以半角逗号（,）分隔，如果为空则返回最近20个作业列表。
description.en: The IDs of the jobs to query. You can get job IDs from the response of the [SubmitFpDBDeleteJob](~~209341~~) operation. To query multiple jobs, separate the IDs with a comma (,). If you omit this parameter, the operation returns the 20 most recent jobs.

descriptions.zh:
本接口通过清空或删除DNA库作业ID进行查询，如果不传入ID则默认返回最近20个作业列表。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~342832~~)。
descriptions.en:
You can call this operation to query jobs by specifying their job IDs. If you do not provide any job IDs, the operation returns a list of the 20 most recent jobs.

## QPS limit

The QPS limit for this operation is 100 calls per second per account. Exceeding this limit triggers throttling, which may affect your business. For more information, see [QPS limits](~~342832~~).
